question: How many customers don't have a state recorded?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customers WHERE State IS NULL

question: How many tracks have no composer listed?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tracks WHERE Composer IS NULL

question: How many tracks have never been sold?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tracks WHERE TrackId NOT IN (SELECT TrackId FROM invoice_items)

question: How many artists have no albums?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM artists WHERE ArtistId NOT IN (SELECT ArtistId FROM albums)

question: How many invoices were issued in the first quarter of 2010?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM invoices WHERE InvoiceDate >= '2010-01-01' AND InvoiceDate < '2010-04-01'

question: How many invoices were issued in December, across all years?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM invoices WHERE strftime('%m', InvoiceDate) = '12'

question: How many different customers have bought at least one Jazz track?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT i.CustomerId) FROM invoices i JOIN invoice_items ii ON ii.InvoiceId = i.InvoiceId JOIN tracks t ON t.TrackId = ii.TrackId JOIN genres g ON g.GenreId = t.GenreId WHERE g.Name = 'Jazz'

question: What is the average track length in minutes, rounded to 2 decimals?
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(Milliseconds) / 60000.0, 2) FROM tracks

question: How many albums have more than 20 tracks?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT AlbumId FROM tracks WHERE AlbumId IS NOT NULL GROUP BY AlbumId HAVING COUNT(*) > 20)

question: Which employees have never been the support rep for any customer? Return their first and last names.
gold_sql: SELECT FirstName, LastName FROM employees WHERE EmployeeId NOT IN (SELECT SupportRepId FROM customers WHERE SupportRepId IS NOT NULL)

question: What percentage of invoices have a billing country of USA? Round to 2 decimals.
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN BillingCountry = 'USA' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) FROM invoices

question: Which 3 genres brought in the most revenue from track sales? Return the genre name and the revenue rounded to 2 decimals.
gold_sql: SELECT g.Name, ROUND(SUM(ii.UnitPrice * ii.Quantity), 2) FROM genres g JOIN tracks t ON t.GenreId = g.GenreId JOIN invoice_items ii ON ii.TrackId = t.TrackId GROUP BY g.GenreId, g.Name ORDER BY SUM(ii.UnitPrice * ii.Quantity) DESC LIMIT 3

question: How many tracks are longer than the average track?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tracks WHERE Milliseconds > (SELECT AVG(Milliseconds) FROM tracks)

question: How many customers have bought tracks from at least 5 different genres?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT i.CustomerId FROM invoices i JOIN invoice_items ii ON ii.InvoiceId = i.InvoiceId JOIN tracks t ON t.TrackId = ii.TrackId GROUP BY i.CustomerId HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT t.GenreId) >= 5)

question: Which support employee's customers spent the most in total? Return the employee's first and last name only.
gold_sql: SELECT e.FirstName, e.LastName FROM employees e JOIN customers c ON c.SupportRepId = e.EmployeeId JOIN invoices i ON i.CustomerId = c.CustomerId GROUP BY e.EmployeeId, e.FirstName, e.LastName ORDER BY SUM(i.Total) DESC LIMIT 1

question: How many invoices have more than 5 line items?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT InvoiceId FROM invoice_items GROUP BY InvoiceId HAVING COUNT(*) > 5)

question: What was the total of all invoices in 2012, rounded to 2 decimals?
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(Total), 2) FROM invoices WHERE strftime('%Y', InvoiceDate) = '2012'

question: How many customers use a Gmail address?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customers WHERE Email LIKE '%@gmail.com'

question: How many different artists have at least one track that was sold?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT al.ArtistId) FROM invoice_items ii JOIN tracks t ON t.TrackId = ii.TrackId JOIN albums al ON al.AlbumId = t.AlbumId

question: How many customers live in a country where the company also has an employee?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customers WHERE Country IN (SELECT Country FROM employees)
